newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Salomon Brothers to open Israel office.
newsitem.headline: Salomon Brothers to open Israel office.

text.p: The U.S. investment bank Salomon Brothers will open a representative office in Israel next month, industry sources said on Tuesday.
The firm plans to increase its activity, particularly in the area of initial public offerings by Israeli companies in the United States.
It will join a handful of other investment banks, including Lehman Brothers, Oppenheimer and Smith Barney, which have opened offices in Israel.
Several other firms, such as Prudential Securities, are represented in Israel by local investment banks.
Salomon Brothers is advising Elbit Ltd on its split into three companies and plans to underwrite the U.S. offering of Net Vision, an Israeli Internet provider.
